item.title: As Ukrainian regions start preparing for next winter, Kyiv lags behind
item.description: Regional leaders and mayors met with President Volodymyr Zelensky in Kyiv on March 3 to approve plans for the upcoming winter. item.title: What to do if you spot an Iranian Shahed drone
item.description: A Shahed drone has a distinct triangular shape and narrow, straight wings. At the back, there's a small propeller engine which gives off a shrill buzz, a sound often compared to a moped or chainsaw.

item.title: Russian tanker reportedly on fire in Mediterranean Sea, media reports
item.description: A Russian-flagged liquified natural gas (LNG) tanker, the Arctic Metagaz, has reportedly caught fire in the Mediterranean Sea, multiple media outlets reported on March 3.

item.title: Merz urges Trump to increase pressure on Russia
item.description: "Russia is playing for time here, and in doing so is also acting against the will of the American president. In today's talks, I called for increasing the pressure on Moscow," German Chancellor Friedrich Merz said on March 3 after meeting with U.S. President Donald Trump.
